source_snapshot.procedure: Capture dmidecode before and after, compare a mixed list of Type 3 chassis and Type 29 current-probe fields.
source_snapshot.criteria: Information is correct and remains correct after reboot.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek truncates Type 29 to a header plus one line, suppresses errors and omits the required reboot and mixed-structure resolution.

original_test_intent.purpose: Validate every SMBIOS Type 29 Electrical Current Probe structure against the platform specification and prove that its defined values remain correct across one reboot, while flagging the source's unrelated chassis-field list rather than treating it as Type 29.
original_test_intent.target: All Type 29 current-probe structures published by the selected SUT BIOS before and after reboot. Manufacturer, Chassis Type, Version, Serial, Asset Tag, chassis states and Security Status belong to other structures, principally Type 3, and are not Type 29 fields.
original_test_intent.scope: One complete pre-reboot Type 29 capture, one approved reboot, and one complete post-reboot capture on the same SUT/BIOS. Companion chassis/identity validation is outside this row until the owner explicitly resolves the contaminated field list.
original_test_intent.operation: Capture unfiltered Type 29 output and raw structure data where needed, parse each handle's Description; Location and Status; Maximum/Minimum; Resolution; Tolerance; Accuracy; OEM-defined; and optional Nominal Value, apply normative units/unknown sentinels, compare with the product matrix, reboot once and repeat/diff by stable probe identity.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 5 attended and 5 machine minutes and requires one before/after reboot comparison. No repeated reboot loop is specified.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Each required Type 29 instance is structurally valid, maps to the intended current probe, matches the product-specific field matrix with correct units/sentinel handling, and remains equivalent after reboot except for owner-approved dynamic/status changes. Unrelated Type 3 fields cannot be used to pass Type 29.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Same-SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode identity; expected probe matrix; complete raw/decoded Type 29 before and after; handles/descriptions/location/status and numeric raw/decoded fields; structure length and optional-field presence; reboot timeline; field-level diff; preserved logs and no-mutation/no-clear audit.
ambiguities: The procedure incorrectly mixes Type 3 chassis/identity/status fields into a Type 29 case.
The platform expected probe count, mapping and values are absent.
The owner has not defined whether any status/value is allowed to vary with operating conditions across reboot.
source_conflicts: The title and Type 29 field tail identify an Electrical Current Probe test, but the first nine listed items are chassis/identity/status fields not contained in Type 29.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly identifies the mixed-structure source conflict, requires complete pre/post evidence and an approved reboot, and rejects log clearing. It does not spell out the normative Type 29 units, 0x8000 unknown sentinel or conditional Nominal Value presence, leaving room for an apparently stable but wrongly decoded structure to pass.

applicable_history.decision: V2 requires the owner to separate Type 29 from chassis fields. No later user ruling resolves the contaminated items or supplies expected values.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2's class and reboot boundary, but make Type 29 decoding normative and exclude the unrelated Type 3 fields pending owner disposition. Safe pre-reboot Actual Value capture is allowed; final persistence testing needs the matrix, conflict resolution and reboot approval.

available_now: The intended Type 29 structure, complete normative field layout and single reboot persistence criterion are identifiable.
Complete pre-reboot Actual Values can be collected read-only before the product matrix or reboot approval is available.
missing_inputs: The BIOS/test owner must remove or separately assign the Type 3 chassis/identity fields and provide the required Type 29 instance/value matrix.
The owner must define dynamic-status/value tolerance across reboot and approve the reboot/recovery window.
The automation owner must supply a qualified dmidecode/raw-table parser that preserves all structures and sentinel/length semantics.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BIOS/test owner resolves field ownership and expected values; the lab owner approves reboot/recovery; the automation owner validates the parser.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Capture complete pre-reboot Type 29 raw/decoded structures and structural validation results without clearing logs.
Inventory any separately observed Type 3 data as source-conflict context only, not Type 29 acceptance.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not use grep-truncated output, suppress errors, fold Type 3 fields into Type 29, invent values/units, treat 0x8000 as a real measurement, reboot without approval, clear logs or change firmware/power settings.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Resolve the mixed field list, receive per-probe expectations and allowed dynamic differences, qualify the parser, capture pre state, perform one approved reboot, verify same target and compare every Type 29 field with length/sentinel semantics.

revision_candidate.test_name: SMBIOS Type 29 Electrical Current Probe Persistence Across Reboot
revision_candidate.purpose: Validate all SMBIOS Type 29 Electrical Current Probe structures against the platform matrix before and after one approved reboot, excluding unrelated chassis fields.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server BIOS/SMBIOS implementation and OS exposing firmware tables to a qualified dmidecode/raw-table reader, with approved reboot and recovery access.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every Type 29 handle and its defined fields across one pre/post reboot pair. Type 3 chassis/identity fields are excluded unless moved to a separate approved contract.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Verified identities/versions; owner-resolved field list; required Type 29 instance/mapping/value matrix; allowed dynamic changes; qualified dmidecode/parser; protected OS access; reboot approval/window/recovery; evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture complete `dmidecode --type 29` stdout/stderr/exit status and raw structure bytes where required. Parse every instance and validate length, Description, Location/Status, Maximum/Minimum, Resolution, Tolerance, Accuracy, OEM-defined and optional Nominal Value using normative units and unknown sentinels. Compare with the platform matrix, perform one approved reboot, verify same SUT/BIOS and repeat/diff every instance.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct host/BIOS/SMBIOS verified; source conflict resolved; expected matrix and dynamic policy supplied; parser qualified; logs preserved; reboot/recovery approved; no concurrent firmware update.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/timestamps; field-resolution decision; expected matrix; complete pre/post raw and decoded Type 29 for each handle; structure length; raw/decoded numeric values and sentinel handling; reboot/boot evidence; instance/field diff; preserved logs; no-write/no-clear audit.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: DMTF SMBIOS Specification DSP0134 version 3.10.0, Type 29 Electrical Current Probe section, constrained by the target's implemented SMBIOS version and the owner-approved platform probe matrix. Type 3 fields require a separate reference/contract.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: SMBIOS reads only; one approved reboot is the sole state change. Do not clear logs, truncate/suppress command evidence, modify firmware/SMBIOS/power controls, expose sensitive identity/OEM data or reinterpret unknown sentinels as measurements.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: The BIOS owner resolves the mixed fields and expected matrix. The lab owner approves the reboot and recovery plan; read-only pre-capture needs no additional interactive approval on an authorized SUT.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Automation can parse/compare supplied rules and execute an approved reboot. The BIOS engineer decides field ownership, product-specific mappings/values and allowed status/value changes across reboot.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On reboot failure or unexpected firmware/SMBIOS change, stop repeated reboot, preserve console/log/table evidence and use the approved independent recovery path. Do not flash or reset firmware as improvised recovery.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved Type 3/Type 29 ownership; missing matrix/dynamic policy; wrong host/firmware; parser truncation; malformed/duplicate/missing structure; invalid length/unit/sentinel handling; reboot not approved; boot/recovery failure; sensitive-data exposure; or any firmware/power/log mutation.

identified_defects: The source mixes Type 3 chassis fields into Type 29.
DeepSeek captures neither complete Type 29 nor the required reboot pair.
V2 omits exact Type 29 units, 0x8000 sentinel and conditional Nominal Value semantics.
The product probe matrix and allowed dynamic changes are missing.
reason_for_change: Turn V2's broad mixed-structure warning into an exact Type 29 contract that can detect decoding and optional-field errors without silently validating unrelated chassis data.

new_technical_evidence.title: SMBIOS Specification
new_technical_evidence.applicability: SMBIOS Type 29 implementations, constrained by the target-advertised SMBIOS version
new_technical_evidence.supports: Each Type 29 instance describes one electrical current probe. Maximum/Minimum/Nominal and Tolerance use milliamps, Resolution uses tenths of milliamps, Accuracy uses hundredths of a percent, 0x8000 represents unknown for the numeric measurement fields, and Nominal Value exists only when structure length exceeds 14h.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The product-specific probe inventory/values and owner disposition of Type 3 fields are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Identifies exactly which listed fields belong to Type 29.
Defines numeric units, unknown handling and optional Nominal Value.
Defines one pre/post reboot pair and separates permitted dynamic changes from persistence failure.
resolved_blockers: Complete pre-reboot Type 29 Actual Value and structural evidence can be collected before the matrix or reboot approval arrives.
remaining_blockers: Final verdict needs owner resolution of mixed fields, product matrix, dynamic policy and reboot approval/recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 makes the mixed-structure defect executable as a safe exclusion rule and adds field-level normative decoding that V2 lacked, preventing stable but incorrectly scaled or sentinel values from passing.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 1941 names Type 29 and requires correctness before/after reboot but mixes chassis and current-probe fields.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 detects the field contamination and reboot gap but lacks exact Type 29 numeric/optional-field semantics.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow complete pre-read; require conflict resolution, matrix and reboot approval for persistence; prohibit log clear and firmware/power mutation.
